subject: Tri-party co-sell demo (Orbit SI + AWS): timebox, breakout ops, and preflight
messages:
From: Ethan Morales <ethan@orbit-systems.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: lina.zhou@aws-partners.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo — proposed windows

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for taking the lead on the tri-party demo. Orbit is excited to show the joint flows for the AWS Marketplace listing and our SI-enabled deployment pattern. Quick housekeeping from our side:

- We need a 45 minute main session + two 15-minute breakout rooms (billing/marketplace flow, and a technical deep-dive).
- Attendee list: Orbit PM + Solutions Eng (me), Orbit infra lead (Maya Rao), AWS partner rep (Lina).
- Tech ask: please confirm the runtime image we should deploy in the sandbox (we currently have v1.3.2 and a staging branch with quantized model artifacts).

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-12-08 09:00–10:00
- Thu 2026-12-09 13:00–14:00
- Mon 2026-12-13 11:00–12:00

We attached a short runbook (orbit-demo-runbook-v2.pdf) and a stack diagram. Can your team confirm the preferred slot and whether Redwood will host the main session or we should share host duties with AWS?

Thanks — Ethan

Attachments: orbit-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (9 pages — run order, breakout hosts, slide deck links), integration-stack-diagram.png (PNG, 1.8MB)

--
Ethan Morales
Senior Solutions Engineer, Orbit Systems
ethan@orbit-systems.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Ethan Morales <ethan@orbit-systems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lina Zhou <lina.zhou@aws-partners.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo — proposed windows

Ethan — thanks for the notes and the runbook. Looping in Vanessa (Partner PM) and Karthik (Solutions) to iron out hosting and ops. A few quick items from Redwood: 

1) Slot: Thu 2026-12-09 13:00–14:00 PST works best for our APAC-overlap folks; please hold for now.
2) Host: Redwood will host the primary Zoom and handle recording + transcript. AWS can be co-host for the marketplace portion; please confirm if you want AWS to share slides or we should put the marketplace flow under a breakout.
3) Runtime image: Karthik — can you confirm which image tag we should use in the demo sandbox (we ideally run the quantized staging artifacts to match production perf)?
4) Breakouts: propose the two breakouts run in parallel at T+30 (billing/marketplace with Lina + Vanessa; deep-dive with Orbit SE + Karthik). Each breakout 15 minutes, 5 minutes to rotate back.

Operational asks for Ethan/Orbit before the run:
- A short `requirements.txt` of any additional libraries and the exact model artifact name (so our infra can pre-pull).
- A screenshot of the Marketplace listing flow you plan to demonstrate (so we can test screen-sharing flows and zoom breakout visibility).

I've downloaded your runbook and stack diagram and left a few inline comments (see Drive link). If we get confirmation today, I'll send a calendar invite and a preflight checklist for Tuesday.

Cheers,

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
--

> 
> Thanks again for taking the lead on the tri-party demo...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ethan Morales <ethan@orbit-systems.com>, Lina Zhou <lina.zhou@aws-partners.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo — proposed windows

Stephanie / team — I can confirm the image tag and infra details:

- Demo image: redwood/demo-run:vstaging-quant-202612 (we'll pre-pull to the sandbox nodes).
- Model artifact: orbit/model-prod-1.3.2-quant (we have a matching config file in the runbook).
- Network: we'll open ports for telemetry and enable a short-lived service-account key for Orbit to hit the sandbox endpoint — details in the runbook.

Ops plan I recommend: Redwood hosts, AWS co-hosts the marketplace breakout, Orbit handles the deep-dive. I'll join the deep-dive as backup. Vanessa — can you confirm production PM attendance and whether we should record the marketplace breakout separately for AWS compliance?

Sooj, I'll need the Zoom link, breakout room names, and an internal tag so we can add SLO notes to the runbook. I'll also attach a tiny health-check script (one-liner) we can run 10 minutes prior to the call.

Karthik
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan@orbit-systems.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo — final slot and preflight checklist

All — locking Thu 2026-12-09 13:00–14:00 PST for the tri-party demo. Quick checklist and next steps: 

- Calendar invite: sent to all external and internal participants; Redwood Zoom (link embedded in invite).
- Breakouts: Billing/Marketplace (Lina + Vanessa) | Technical deep-dive (Orbit SE + Karthik).
- Preflight run: Tue 2026-12-07 09:00–09:20 PST — mandatory for all presenters (recording off).
- Deliverables from Orbit by Mon 2026-12-06 EOD: requirements.txt, screenshot of marketplace flow, and confirmation of attendee list (Maya Rao + Orbit PM).
- Attachments: I've uploaded the final runbook (orbit-demo-runbook-v2.pdf) to Drive and added the zoom room names and SRE contact.

Ethan / Orbit: please reply-all with the deliverables and any required escalation contacts. If there are any changes to the image tag or artifact name, notify ops immediately — we will not change artifacts after Tuesday's preflight.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
